annotatedSteps.description: Assumption of uniform strip width and expressing dimensions of the pool
annotatedSteps.studentWork: Let the uniform width of the grass strip be x m. Length of pool = (50 - 2x) m, breadth of pool = (40 - 2x) m
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct representation of dimensions in terms of x

annotatedSteps.description: Formulating the equation from the given area of the strip
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
Area of park - area of pool = area of grass strip
50 × 40 - (50 - 2x)(40 - 2x) = 1184

annotatedSteps.description: Expanding and reducing to standard quadratic equation
Rejecting inappropriate root and calculating final dimensions
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
x = 37 is rejected (40 - 2x would be negative) ⇒ x = 8
Length of pool = 50 - 16 = 36 m
Breadth of pool = 40 - 16 = 24 m
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Proper reasoning for rejection and correct pool dimensions with units

teacherNote: Excellent and structured solution. Every step, from formulating the equation to rejecting the impossible root and stating dimensions with correct units, is executed flawlessly.

rubric.point: Defining variable and expressions for pool dimensions in terms of strip width
Setting up the algebraic equation using area relationship
Simplifying to standard quadratic equation form
Solving the quadratic equation to find values of x
Valid contextual rejection of root and stating final dimensions of pool with units
